velious.label: Velious

Character:KeepLevelOverMax.reason: Preservation exception: retain existing characters above the selected era cap; do not truncate their level when experience changes.

Character:RestRegenEnabled.reason: Disable later rest-state regeneration; ordinary HP and mana regeneration remain active.

Character:SoDClientUseSoDHPManaEnd.reason: Use the older HP/mana/endurance formulas rather than later Seeds of Destruction formulas on RoF2.

Character:HPRegenMultiplier.reason: Use unmultiplied normal HP regeneration; this does not replace engine regeneration formulas.

Character:ManaRegenMultiplier.reason: Use unmultiplied normal mana regeneration; this does not implement TAKP-specific meditate code.

Character:EnduranceRegenMultiplier.reason: Use unmultiplied normal endurance regeneration; RoF2 endurance remains a client/engine difference.

Character:BaseHPRegenBonusRaces.reason: Keep the Troll/Iksar regeneration bonus mask shared by upstream and TAKP.

Character:RespawnFromHover.reason: Use death/respawn without the later hover selection window.

Character:EnableXTargetting.reason: Disable the later Underfoot extended-targeting feature on RoF2.

Character:EnableAggroMeter.reason: Disable the later Rain of Fear aggro-meter feature on RoF2.

Character:UseOldConSystem.reason: Use the engine pre-Secrets of Faydwer consider system.

Character:UseOldBindWound.reason: Use the engine original bind-wound implementation: normal 50% limit with the skilled monk exception.

Character:EnableBardMelody.reason: Disable the later /melody convenience feature for these classic-era presets.

Character:HealOnLevel.reason: Do not completely heal on leveling; matches the TAKP default database.

Character:ItemCastsUseFocus.reason: Keep item click casts from using level-limited focuses; matches the TAKP default database.

Character:LeaveCorpses.reason: Leave player corpses; matches the TAKP default database.

Character:LeaveNakedCorpses.reason: Retain naked player corpses as in the TAKP default database.

Character:DeathItemLossLevel.reason: Use TAKP default item-corpse threshold level 10; the upstream corpse implementation remains.

Character:DeathExpLossLevel.reason: Use TAKP default experience-loss threshold level 11; upstream uses an inclusive threshold.

Character:CorpseDecayTime.reason: Seven-day corpse decay, mapped from TAKP Character:CorpseDecayTimeMS.

Character:EmptyCorpseDecayTime.reason: Three-hour empty-corpse decay, mapped from the TAKP millisecond key.

Character:CorpseResTime.reason: Three-hour resurrection window, mapped from TAKP Character:CorpseResTimeMS.

Character:UnmemSpellsOnDeath.reason: Forget memorized spells on death; spellbook ownership is unchanged.

Spells:BuffsFadeOnDeath.reason: Use ordinary loss of nonpersistent buffs on death.

Spells:EnableBlockedBuffs.reason: Disable the later blocked-buff convenience system.

Spells:UseClassicHarmTouchDamage.reason: Use the engine pre-2007 Harm Touch damage calculation.

Combat:ClassicTauntSystem.reason: Use the engine pre-2006 taunt system.

Combat:ClassicMasterWu.reason: Use engine classic random-special Master Wu behavior when the expansion-tagged AA is available.

World:EnableTutorialButton.reason: Disable the later tutorial button; retain existing start-zone and bind data.

World:EnableReturnHomeButton.reason: Disable the later Return Home button; retain existing home and bind data.

Mercs:AllowMercs.reason: Mercenaries are outside Velious, Luclin and Planes of Power.

AA:NormalizedAAEnabled.reason: Disable the TSS-and-later normalized-AA experience system.

AA:ModernAAScalingEnabled.reason: Disable modern AA catch-up acceleration; retain baseline normal AA rate and stored AA points.

Bazaar:EnableWarpToTrader.reason: Disable later instant travel to bazaar traders.

Expansion:UseCurrentExpansionAAOnly.reason: Reject AA ranks with database expansion later than the selected era; stored AA is not deleted.

Expansion:AutoGrantAAExpansion.reason: Disable AA autogrant; existing purchased AA remains stored.

World:UseClientBasedExpansionSettings.reason: Honor the selected era mask rather than RoF2 client-era defaults.

Character:MaxLevel.reason: Use the Velious normal level cap.

Character:MaxExpLevel.reason: Explicitly cap experience so an inherited higher MaxExpLevel cannot override the era level cap.

Character:SkillCapMaxLevel.reason: Limit skill-cap lookup to the era level cap using the existing PEQ skill_caps table.

Expansion:CurrentExpansion.reason: Set engine content expansion index. The launcher must reversibly overlay the managed era rules on default because startup/content routing reloads default, then restore original rows and per-zone assignments.

World:ExpansionSettings.reason: Use cumulative Kunark/Velious/Luclin/PoP client mask for this era.

World:CharacterSelectExpansionSettings.reason: Use the same era mask at character selection rather than an inherited override.

Items:DisableSpellFocusEffects.reason: Disable worn spell focuses before Luclin and enable from Luclin, matching TAKP item-loader expansion switch. Bard instruments and item records are retained.

limitations: These are PEQ-compatible era presets on the existing EQEmu server and RoF2 client, not a TAKP engine/database replacement.
Later-zone access follows zone.expansion and bypass_expansion_check for ordinary characters; GM characters bypass the engine expansion gate.
Min/max-tagged content is filtered, but missing or inaccurate PEQ tags can retain later spawns, items, loot, merchants and expansion-spanning quest behavior in older zones.

The RoF2 expansion mask affects client creation availability. The pinned server validates race/class/deity/start-zone combinations without separately checking their expansion requirement; existing characters are not changed.
AA availability depends on aa_ranks.expansion metadata. Existing purchased AA and unspent points remain stored; the preset does not clear AA allocation or implement TAKP Character:DisableAAs.
Existing over-cap characters retain their level. Normal leveling follows the selected cap, while quest character-specific level limits remain inherited.

Baseline XP multipliers, group/raid rewards, XP penalty curves, con scaling and zone modifiers are retained: TAKP formulas and AK-only bonuses cannot be safely copied without recalibrating stored character experience.
TAKP charm, resist, pet XP, monk AC, item bane/required-level, spell progression and hell-level smoothing algorithms have no complete equivalent in these upstream rule values.

The preset requires a stopped-server switch/restart. A live static/content reload can reset inherited per-zone preferences to default until another restart; the launcher does not use live rule reload.
Velious filters expansion-tagged Luclin AA and hides expansion-dependent creation choices where RoF2 honors the mask, but does not erase existing AA, Beastlords or Vah Shir characters.
